preconditions.description: The number of cities is between 2 and 200.
The number of roads is between 1 and 50000.
The cost of gold and silver coins is between 1 and 10^9 tugriks.
The cities connected by each road are numbered from 1 to N.
The gold and silver coin requirements for each road are between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: output is a non-negative integer or '<image>'
postconditions.description: The output is the minimal cost of the gift in Olympian tugriks or '<image>' if no gift satisfies the requirements.
